save-file-error: An error occurred when trying to decode your save file
save-file-confirmation: Are you sure you uploaded CCGameManager.dat ?
security-notice: Global Stats Viewer will never store or receive your passwords. Save file decoding is entirely done locally.
successfully-imported-completions-2: You can now enjoy a more detailed breakdown of your completions!
save-import-description-1: This menu allows you to import every single rated level you have beaten in your Geometry Dash profile. While
save-import-description-2: allows you to import publicly available data, this menu uses a save file-based approach to gather completed levels. You can still use Global Stats Viewer without needing to import data from your save file, but your stats will be limited to per-difficulty numbers instead of actually knowing which levels you have completed.
save-import-offline-1: This menu works 100% offline! Your save file will
save-import-offline-2: be uploaded to our servers. Instead, your save file is decoded locally and the processed data is then sent to our servers.
save-import-offline-3: Global Stats Viewer will never have access to your accounts and passwords.
drag-save-file-here: Drag your Geometry Dash save file here
this-has-been-made-possible-by: This has been made possible by
run-ul-2: Updated Leaderboard bot on Discord before uploading your save file! This makes sure your Geometry Dash data is up to date with what your save file contains.
